Officer's narrative
Officer narrative. On arriavl at the intersection in Houston, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision. Driver 1 reported
that while turning left across oncoming traffic, Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1
stated having sustained a wrist fracture and was tranpsorted for treatment. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events
as described. Two independent witnesses and photographs taken at the scene are consistent with that account. The
damage to both vehicles corresponds to the angle and force of the impact. Driver 1 was identified as a resident of the
same household as the registered policyholder. Passenger, seated in the rear, was not injured. It could not be fully
determined from the scene where Driver 1 was positioned in the vehicle at the moment of impact, as Driver 1 gave
differing accounts when questioned. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was observed or reported by any party.
Both vehicles were removed from the roadway by tow.
</page>
